names: Maximum open circuit PV array voltage
rules.basis: The SmartSolar and BlueSolar sheets state one PV input limit, 'Max. PV voltage' or 'Max. input voltage', and the manual says it is the open-circuit voltage the array must never exceed at any temperature.
The sheets state the PV power the controller will use per battery voltage, one column each; the bank voltage is in the figure's name.
'Rated charge current' is the controller's output current to the battery; 'Charge current' on an inverter/charger sheet is the charger's.
The sheets state the nominal battery voltages the unit is made for.
The MultiPlus and Phoenix sheets state continuous output power at 25, 40 and 65 °C; the 25 °C figure is printed in VA and reads as a gap until an apparent-power key exists.
'Zero-load power' is what the inverter draws with nothing connected; the search-mode figure carries its mode in the name.
The sheets state the nominal AC output voltage, often with its tolerance, which the parser refuses rather than halves.
